blocks.text: Khurdbeeni aaloodgi pani ka bacteria, viruses, protozoa aur parasites jaise nuqsan-deh khurdbeeni jandaron se aaloodah hona hai, jo insanon aur janwaron ko sakht nuqsan de sakte hain. Yeh aam taur par na saaf ya kam saaf kiye sewage, janwaron ke fuzle, hospital ke kachre aur kheton se behte pani se aati hai. Aise pani mein aam jarasim Escherichia coli, Salmonella aur Giardia hain. Pani ke khurdbeeni jandaar pani se phailne wali bimariyon, jaise cholera, typhoid, pechish (dysentery) aur hepatitis A, ki bari wajah hain. Pani ubalna (100 C) zyada tar bacteria, viruses aur protozoa maar kar pani peene ke qabil banata hai, lekin sirf ubalne se doosri aaloodgi nahi nikalti.

Kimiyai aaloodgi mein aksar mercury, lead, arsenic aur cadmium jaisi zehreeli heavy metals aur pesticides aur herbicides jaise zarai kimiyai maddey shamil hain. Heavy metals sanati ikhraj, kaan kani aur kachre ke ghalat thikane lagane se pani mein aati hain.

items: Mercury zyada tar koyla jalane, sone ki kaan kani, aur thermometer ya battery banane ke sanati kachre se pani mein aati hai. Tah (sediments) mein bacteria inorganic mercury ko methylmercury ([CH3Hg]+) mein badalte hain, jo zyada khatarnak hai.

Lead ke bare zaraye leaded petrol (ab duniya bhar mein mamnoo), purani plumbing (lead ke pipes), lead-acid batteries aur paints hain. Lead ions (Pb2+) aksar pipes ke zang (corrosion) se pani mein aate hain.
Metal plating, plastic stabilisers aur phosphate khaad ki napaki pani mein cadmium ke bare zaraye hain.

blocks.text: Heavy metals ke atomic masses aur densities zyada hain. Kyunke yeh qudrati taur par galti nahi (non-biodegradable), yeh jandaron ke tissues mein jama hoti aur khaas taur par khatarnak hain. Methylmercury charbi mein bohat hal-pazeer hai, is liye aasani se hayatiyati jhilliyan paar karti aur biomagnification karti hai; yeh taqatwar neurotoxin hai jo khoon-dimagh ki rukawat paar karti, aur lamba samna Minamata bimari (ataxia, hathon pairon ka sun hona aur aam patthon ki kamzori) laata hai. Lead haemoglobin ki paidawar mein mudakhlat kar ke khoon ki kami (anaemia) karta hai; bachon mein yeh jama hone wala zehr hai jo na-qabil-e-wapsi asabi nuqsan aur nashonuma mein der karta hai. Cadmium ka taveel istemal itai-itai bimari laata hai, jis mein cadmium haddiyon mein calcium ki jagah le kar unhein bohat bhurbhura bana deta hai; yeh gurdon ko bhi sakht nuqsan (nephrotoxicity) deta hai.

blocks.title: Cadmium calcium ki jagah kyun leta hai
blocks.text: Kitab Cd2+ ko haddi mein Ca2+ ki jagah leta dikhati aur kehti hai ke Cd2+ ki 'charge density zyada' hai. Dono ions ka charge 2+ hai aur radii bohat milte julte hain (Cd2+ taqreeban 95 pm aur Ca2+ 100 pm), isi liye Cd2+ haddi mein calcium ki jagahon mein fit ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Zaraye aur asraat ke teen cards. Mercury: koyla jalana, sone ki kaan kani, thermometer aur battery ki sanatein; methylmercury charbi mein hal-pazeer neurotoxin jo Minamata bimari karta. Lead: leaded petrol, lead pipes, batteries, paints; anaemia aur bachon mein asabi nuqsan. Cadmium: plating, plastic stabilisers, phosphate khaad; itai-itai bimari aur gurdon ka nuqsan. Neeche Ca2+ se Cd2+ ka teer haddi mein cadmium ka calcium ki jagah lena dikhata.
blocks.caption: Pani mein heavy metals (topic 33.3 ka asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har heavy metal ke apne zaraye aur jism mein apna hadaf hai. In mein se koi bhi toot'ti nahi, is liye yeh waqt ke saath jandaron mein jama hoti hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Minamata ka saniha 1950 ki dahai mein Minamata, Japan mein sanati aaloodgi ka shadeed waqia tha. Pani mein chhori gayi methylmercury se wasee mercury zehr phaila, hazaron log asabi nuqsan ka shikar hue aur paidaishi naqais, amwaat aur mahol ki tabahi hui. (Kitab ki mareez ki tasveer shamil nahi ki gayi.)

DDT aur glyphosate jaise pesticides aur herbicides aik aur khatarnak group hain jo pani ko aaloodah kar ke sehat ke sangeen masail paida karte hain. In ke bare zaraye kheton ka behta pani aur gharelu baghbani hain. Bohat se non-polar aur pani mein na-hal-pazeer lekin machhliyon aur parindon ke charbi wale tissues mein bohat hal-pazeer hain. DDT jaise bohat se purane pesticides der-pa organic aaloodgi (persistent organic pollutants, POPs) hain. Pesticides hormones ki kharabi aur nashonuma ke masail se jure hain, aur kimiyai aaloodgi pani ka mayaar girati, hayatiyati tanawwu kam karti aur aabi ecosystems bigarti hai.

blocks.title: Tamam pesticides non-polar nahi
blocks.text: Kitab DDT aur glyphosate jaise pesticides aur herbicides ko 'non-polar aur pani mein na-hal-pazeer' kehti hai. Yeh DDT par sahi hai, lekin glyphosate polar aur pani mein bohat hal-pazeer hai. Hissa 33.1 bhi batata hai ke polar pesticides ghul kar pani ke chakkar mein dakhil hote hain. Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.

Bohat se pesticides endocrine disruptors ka kaam karte hain jo oestrogen jaise qudrati hormones ki naqal karte hain. Is se jangli jandaron mein nasal-kashi ki nakami (maslan parindon ke ande ke chhilke ka patla hona) hoti aur insanon mein hormonal cancers se talluq hai. Polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) bijli ke transformers mein thanda karne ke liye use hote the; yeh khatarnak kachre ki jagahon se pani mein riste, mumkina insani carcinogens shumar hote, immune system dabate aur chloracne jaisi jild ki bimariyan paida karte hain.

blocks.alt: Insani jism ka saada khaaka, lakeerein labels tak. Baen: dil, cardiac failure; phephre, lung cancer; jigar, hepatic necrosis; ovaries, ovarian cancer; patthe, musculoskeletal bimariyan. Daen: dimagh, Alzheimer ki bimari; thyroid, kam thyroid hormone; khoon, intravascular haemolysis; aantein, ulti aur dast; gurde, renal dysfunction; haddiyan, osteoporosis. Aik dabba pesticides aur heavy metals (Cd, Pb, Cu, Zn) batata.
blocks.caption: Heavy metals aur pesticides ke jism par asraat (Figure 33.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Zehreeli dhatein aur pesticides taqreeban har uzw ko nuqsan de sakte hain. Figure asraat ikatthe batati hai; yeh nahi batati ke kaun sa asar kis maddah se hai.

blocks.text: Ghizai ajza ki aaloodgi, jise eutrophication bhi kehte hain, tab hoti hai jab ghizai ajza, khaas taur par nitrogen aur phosphorus, ki zyada miqdar aam taur par kheton ke behte pani, gande pani ke ikhraj aur toofani pani se aabi zakhiron mein dakhil ho. Agarche yeh ajza paudon ki barhotri ke liye zaruri hain, in ki zyadti algae ki tez barhotri (algal blooms) karti hai. Blooms pani ke andar paudon tak dhoop rok sakte hain. Jab algae mar kar galti hain to bohat oxygen kharch karti hain, aur kam oxygen wale 'murda ilaqe' (dead zones) bante hain jahan aabi zindagi zinda nahi reh sakti. Eutrophication aabi ecosystems bigarti, hayatiyati tanawwu kam karti, machhli ki sanat ko nuqsan deti aur pani ko peene aur tafreeh ke liye kharab karti hai. Peene ke pani mein zyada nitrate khaas taur par shir-khwar bachon ke liye khatarnak hai aur 'blue baby syndrome' (methaemoglobinaemia) kar sakta hai, jis mein nitrates khoon ki oxygen le jane ki salahiyat kam karte hain.

Samandaron mein tel ki aaloodgi, khaas taur par jahazon ke rasao aur girne se, mahol ke liye bara khatra hai. Gira hua tel pani ki satah par tezi se aik tah ki shakal mein phailta hai jo dhoop rokti aur oxygen ka tabadla kam karti hai. Is se machhliyon, parindon aur mammals samet samandari zindagi ko sakht nuqsan hota hai; samandari mammals apni safai karte hue zehreela tel nigal sakte hain, aur machhliyan hydrocarbons se taveel nuqsan utha sakti hain. Tel ki aaloodgi mangroves, coral reefs aur sahilon jaise sahili maskanon ko bhi nuqsan deti hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: teeron se jure paanch dabbe: khaad ke behte pani, sewage aur toofani pani se faltu N aur P; algal bloom; bloom pani ke andar paudon ki dhoop rokta; murda algae gal kar oxygen kharch karti; kam oxygen wala dead zone jahan aabi zindagi marti. Note blue baby syndrome batata. Neeche: samandar ki satah par tel ki gehri tah; teer dikhate ke tah dhoop aur oxygen rokti; note machhliyon, parindon, samandari mammals, mangroves, coral reefs aur sahilon ke nuqsan batata.
blocks.caption: Eutrophication aur tel ki aaloodgi (topic 33.3 ka asal khaaka; Figure 33.3 tasaveer hain).
blocks.long_description: Dono suraton mein pani oxygen khota hai: eutrophication mein galti algae use kharch karti, aur tel girne mein tel ki tah hawa se oxygen ghulne nahi deti.

blocks.text: Samandaron aur doosre aabi zakhiron mein plastic aur thos kachre ki aaloodgi barhta hua mahol ka bohran hai. Har saal karoron ton plastic kachra, botlein, thaile, machhli ke jaal aur microplastics samet, daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein phenka jata hai. Organic maddon ke bar-aks plastics qudrati taur par nahi galte; yeh chhote zarrat mein toot kar sadiyon tak rehte hain. Samandari janwar aksar plastic ko khurak samajh lete, jis se nigalna, dam ghutna ya andaruni chot hoti jo jaan-leva ho sakti hai, aur purane machhli ke saaman aur doosre malbe mein phansna be-shumar kachhuon, dolphins aur parindon ko zakhmi ya halak karta hai. Microplastics food chain mein dakhil ho chuke hain, jis se insani sehat par un ke asraat ki fikr hai. Thos kachra aabi raaste band karta, aabi maskan bigarta aur pani ka mayaar girata hai.

blocks.explanation: Sanati ikhraj, kaan kani aur kachre ka ghalat thikana; maslan koyla jalana, sone ki kaan kani aur thermometer ya battery ki sanat (mercury); leaded petrol, lead pipes, lead-acid batteries aur paints (lead); metal plating, plastic stabilisers aur phosphate khaad (cadmium).

blocks.prompt: Tel ka girna samandari zindagi ke liye kaise khatarnak hai?
blocks.explanation: Tel ki tah dhoop rokti aur oxygen ka tabadla kam karti; janwar safai karte hue zehreela tel nigalte; machhliyan hydrocarbons se taveel nuqsan uthati; aur mangroves aur coral reefs jaise sahili maskan kharab hote hain.

blocks.prompt: DDT jaise pesticides 'non-polar aur pani mein na-hal-pazeer' hain, phir bhi 'pani aaloodah kar ke insani sehat ke sangeen masail' paida karte hain. Samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Bohat thori ghuli miqdar, ya behte pani mein mitti ke zarrat par lada DDT, pani mein pohanchta hai. Charbi mein hal-pazeer aur der-pa hone ki wajah se DDT jandaron ke charbi wale tissues mein jazb hota aur food chain ke har qadam par zyada mutamarkiz hota hai (biomagnification), is liye oopar ke insan zyada khurak lete hain.

items: Jarasim: E. coli, Salmonella, Giardia; cholera, typhoid, pechish, hepatitis A.
Heavy metals: Hg (Minamata), Pb (anaemia), Cd (itai-itai); WHO hudood (Table 33.2).
Pesticides, PCBs: hormones ki kharabi, cancers; eutrophication; tel; plastics.
